entities.name: Roman Catholic Diocese of Famagusta
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Diocese of Famagusta was a Latin Church ecclesiastical jurisdiction or diocese of the Catholic Church. Its episcopal see was the city of Famagusta, on the island of Cyprus during crusader rule, and is now a Latin Catholic titular see.
